name: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B
purpose: Qwen states: designed specifically for coding agents and local development; integrates with Claude Code, Qwen Code, Cline and Trae.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0 with license_link to LICENSE; raw/main/LICENSE returns 404 and the file list has none (2026-11-19). The sibling Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B repo carries the Apache text.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE
architecture.attention: 12 x (3 Gated DeltaNet-MoE + 1 gated attention-MoE), 16 Q / 2 KV heads, head dim 256
architecture.why_this_design: Card claims efficiency at 3B active parameters; no further rationale.

variants.format: GGUF Q4_K_M 48.4 GB, Q5_K_M 56.7 GB, Q8_0 84.8 GB
variants.notes: sizes not read size_gb is the Q4_K_M file

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 20% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 28% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM = 104 GB; about 45% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 61% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from the file size (48.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: GGUF repos exist; architecture is close to the qwen35moe path Tona already runs, not checked

strengths: Official coder from the Qwen team with Apache-2.0
Non-thinking: short outputs for agent loops
Likely FIM-capable family (tokenizers define FIM tokens per research/52)
weaknesses: Older than Ornith and Flash-Next, lower SWE-bench Pro (44.3)
soft.behavior: Sampling T 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 40; no think blocks.
soft.maturity: Qwen: 1749 likes, 336k downloads; 120 quantized versions listed.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 by card (text file missing), Q4_K_M 48.4 GB fits the 24 GB + 96 GB class and 16 GB + 64 GB marginally; superseded in vendor agent quality by Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (SWE-bench Multilingual 64.3 against 71.4) at a smaller size. Keep as the Apache reference for 24 to 32 GB classes.

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)
